functions.name: begin
functions.docs:
Returns a pointer to the first row in the view.
This function is primarily used for compatibility to C++ features and libraries.

functions.name: end
functions.docs:
Returns a pointer the address after the last row in the view.
This function is primarily used for compatibility to C++ features and libraries.

functions.name: GetData
functions.docs: Returns the address of row handles in memory.

functions.name: First
functions.docs:
If the view is not empty, this return the last row handle in the view. Calling this function on an empty view will cause an
assert.

functions.name: Last
functions.docs:
If the view is not empty, this return the last row handle in the view. Calling this function on an empty view will cause an
assert.

functions.name: Num
functions.docs: The number of rows this view shows.

functions.name: NumBytes
functions.docs:
Returns the total number of bytes that are in use by rows. This is may not be the total amount of memory in use by the
container this view maps to.

functions.name: IsSorted
functions.docs: Whether or not the contained rows are numerically ordered from smallest to largest.

functions.name: IsUnique
functions.docs: Whether or all rows in the view only appear once.

functions.name: IsEmpty
functions.docs: Whether or not there are any values in the view.

functions.name: Contains
functions.docs:
Whether or not the view contains the provided row. If the view is sorted a much binary search can be used for a much faster
search otherwise a slower linear search is done.
